div.p: This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

ul.li:
Include all codes defined in
http://www.ama-assn.org/go/cpt

Include codes from
http://snomed.info/sct where concept is-a 71388002 (Procedure)

Include all codes defined in
http://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Coding/ICD10

Include all codes defined in
http://www.ada.org/cdt

Include all codes defined in
http://loinc.org

description.value: Concepts from CPT, SNOMED CT, HCPCS Level II Alphanumeric Codes, ICD-10-PCS,CDT and LOINC code systems that can be used to indicate the type of procedure performed.
